stories.headline: MoonPay seeks bank charter to federally issue stablecoins
stories.body: The white-label crypto payments firm asked the OCC for a stablecoin-focused national trust charter after the agency issued final rulemaking for the GENIUS Act.

stories.headline: Natural Enables Voice Agents to Accept Payments Over the Phone
stories.body: Natural now enables artificial intelligence (AI) agents to accept card payments during live calls, the company said in a Monday (Nov. 23) press release. With the company’s new Natural Voice, a business’s AI voice agent can hand the caller to Natural’s payment agent, ensuring card details never reach the business’s systems, according to the release.
